_note: Hand-written one or two sentence descriptions shown in the site viewer (docs/index.html) when a node is clicked. Keyed by entity id. Merged into docs/data/graph.json by scripts/export_site_graph.py.
count_dracula: An ancient Transylvanian nobleman and vampire. He buys Carfax, an estate near London, and sails to England in boxes of his native earth, where he preys on Lucy and Mina.
abraham_van_helsing: A Dutch doctor, philosopher and scientist from Amsterdam, and Seward's old teacher. He is the first to recognise what is wrong with Lucy and leads the hunt for the Count.
lucy_westenra: Mina's lively, much-admired friend, courted by three men in one day. She becomes the Count's first victim in England.
mina_harker: Born Wilhelmina Murray, a schoolmistress and Jonathan's fiancee, then wife. She types up and orders the diaries, letters and cuttings that make up the book, and becomes central to tracking the Count.
jonathan_harker: A young solicitor from Exeter, sent to Transylvania to settle the Count's purchase of a London house. His journal of his time as a prisoner in Castle Dracula opens the novel.
arthur_holmwood: Lucy's fiance, who becomes Lord Godalming when his father dies. His title and money open many doors during the hunt.
john_seward: A young doctor who runs a lunatic asylum next to Carfax. One of Lucy's suitors; he keeps his diary on a phonograph and studies his patient Renfield.
quincey_morris: A rich, brave young Texan, another of Lucy's suitors and a loyal friend to Arthur and Seward. He joins the hunt with his Winchester and bowie knife.
rm_renfield: A patient in Seward's asylum who eats flies, spiders and birds to absorb their lives. He senses the Count's coming and calls him "Master".
peter_hawkins: Jonathan's employer, a solicitor in Exeter who sends him to Transylvania. A fatherly figure to Jonathan and Mina.
mrs_westenra: Lucy's mother, a widow with a weak heart. Kind but unknowing, she undoes some of Van Helsing's precautions.
petrof_skinsky: A trader in Galatz who deals with the Slovaks and is engaged to receive the Count's box from the ship.
sam_bloxam: A London carrier who moved some of the Count's earth boxes from Carfax. Seward's inquiries lead to him.
thomas_bilder: The keeper of the wolves at the Zoological Gardens, interviewed by a newspaper about Bersicker's escape.
joseph_smollet: A carrier's man living in Walworth who helped move the Count's boxes, and remembers where some of them went.
mr_swales: An elderly Whitby sailor who talks with Mina and Lucy in the churchyard on the cliff, scoffing at the lies on the tombstones.
samuel_billington: A Whitby solicitor to whom the Count's boxes of earth are consigned when they arrive on the Demeter.
donelson: Captain of the Czarina Catherine, the ship that carries the Count's box from London to Galatz. He reports a strangely fast voyage.
immanuel_hildesheim: A shipping agent in Galatz who signed for the Count's box and handed it on to Petrof Skinsky.
mary: A servant in the Harkers' house in Exeter, who shows Van Helsing in when he first calls on Mina.
sister_agatha: A nun at the hospital in Buda-Pesth who nurses Jonathan through brain fever after his escape, and writes to Mina.
enoch: Not a character: the biblical Enoch, who "walked with God", to whom Renfield compares himself.
geordie: A dead man of Whitby buried under the tombstone Mr. Swales calls "a pack of lies", on whose grave Lucy and Mina like to sit.
joseph: Not a character: the name comes from the Hospital of St. Joseph and Ste. Mary in Buda-Pesth, where Jonathan is nursed.
thomas_snelling: Joseph Smollet's mate, a carrier's man in Bethnal Green who helped move the Count's boxes but is too drunk to remember anything.
vincent: A doctor at the North Hospital who treats the children bitten on Hampstead Heath by the "bloofer lady".
arminius: Van Helsing's friend at Buda-Pesth University, who looks into the history of the Voivode Dracula.
attila: Attila the Hun, whose blood the Count boasts runs in his veins.
john_paxton: Two people share this name in the book: a sailor drowned off Cape Farewell, named on a Whitby gravestone, and the President of the Incorporated Law Society, who sends a representative to Mr. Hawkins's funeral.
patrick_hennessey: A doctor who looks after Seward's asylum while Seward is away, and reports on Renfield's attacks on the carriers at Carfax.
rufus_smith: An agent at Lloyd's in London who telegraphs Lord Godalming with news of the Czarina Catherine.
shakespeare: Not a character: William Shakespeare, quoted by Jonathan and by Renfield.
bersicker: A grey wolf that escapes from the Zoological Gardens in London on the night the Count attacks Lucy's house.
demeter: The Russian schooner from Varna that carries the Count to Whitby. It runs aground in a storm with its dead captain lashed to the wheel and no living crew.
